source_attribution: European Space Agency (ESA) Sentinel-2 MSI via Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE)
scientific_notes: Scientific Attribution: Spectral indicators are computed from calibrated Sentinel-2 MSI Top-of-Atmosphere/Bottom-of-Atmosphere radiometry. Green-to-Red reflectance ratio proxies algal chlorophyll pigmentation while Red-channel scattering estimates suspended sediment plumes.
